query: Which team won Super Bowl LIX?
answer: The Philadelphia Eagles won Super Bowl LIX. They beat the Kansas City Chiefs 40–22 on February 9, 2025, at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans [1][2]. The win ended the Chiefs' attempt to win three Super Bowls in a row and was the Eagles' second Super Bowl title [1][3]. Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts was named Super Bowl MVP [1][2]. It was also a rematch of Super Bowl LVII in February 2023, which the Chiefs won.
